messages:
max: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need a single owner for customer-facing comms and a clear policy on who gets a redacted RCA. This keeps things consistent and avoids duplicate outreach.

tara: I volunteer to own the customer-facing summary and the status page copy. Can someone confirm the short-term mitigations and remediation ETA?

leo: Mitigations: enabled burst nodes, bumped cache TTL, and rolled back the last aggressive KV packing patch. Remediation ticket INF-5199 is scoped for a 2-week rollout for the heuristic fix.

ops-bot: Created ticket COMMS-1123 assigned to tara (status-page draft).

legal: Two asks: 1) Confirm "No customer data was exposed" before publishing, 2) We prefer the phrase "redacted root cause analysis" for enterprise requests.

customer-success: We should proactively notify SLA customers and offer an optional 1:1 walkthrough with the engineering owner. They usually want a redacted RCA + timeline.

max: Recurring pattern note: this appears related to KV/prefix eviction during extreme concurrency spikes. Track as a recurring incident pattern and add to the postmortem backlog so we can trend.

tara: Draft status copy (first pass):
"On March 22 we saw elevated latency for a subset of inference requests during a high-concurrency event. We applied short-term mitigations to restore service and are implementing a long-term fix. No customer data was exposed. Enterprise customers can request a redacted root cause analysis and remediation timeline."

legal: Approved that wording, pending final confirmation about data exposure.

max: Action items (I'll add to the postmortem tracker):
- tara: Finalize status page copy + 2-line FAQ (due: 2026-03-29) [owner: tara]
- leo: Post remediation ETA and weekly progress updates to INF-5199 (due: initial ETA 2026-04-05) [owner: leo]
- legal: Confirm forensic check that no customer data was exposed (due: 24h) [owner: legal]
- customer-success: Create outreach list for SLA customers and draft email (due: 2026-03-30) [owner: customer-success]
- max: Add recurring-pattern tag to incident and schedule a trend review next monthly incident review (due: 2026-04-06) [owner: max]

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-03-30 to check COMMS-1123 status.

tara: I'll post the final draft here once legal signs off. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
